node.label: Reduced tissue phosphomannomutase activity
node.definition: Activity of the enzyme phosphomannomutase (EC 5.4.2.8) in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes, fibroblasts, and liver.

evidence.snippet: Congenital disorder of glycosylation, type Ia: Reduced tissue phosphomannomutase activity (frequency 3/3) [PCS]
